source.kind: actual owned COSMO deployment error and readback

applicability: Republishing shipping no-IVT Default into the retained exclusive worker6 verification container with its earlier Test app still published
finding: Default publish returned422 AL0161 from recompilation of the previously installed dependent Test app; new product not installed, confirmed by old954fcc2 artifact readback
rootCause: The prior same-task container retained the Test product and dependent Test extension; shipping Default intentionally removes IVT and makes test-only internal references inaccessible
prevention: Before shipping Default in an owned retained test environment, inspect actual dependent test-app state, uninstall/unpublish only that owned test app without deleting extension data when required, then Default no-IVT -> Test product -> Test app. Never broaden API visibility or alter assertions to bypass this lifecycle boundary. Preserve failed response and readback; do not replay successful writes
status: verified owned setup correction; native and UI/MCP verification remain separate
